policy: Manual outreach ledger only. No mass-spam automation, purchased links, fake experts, or invented studies. Append rows as humans work prospects.

schema.category: running_publication | sports_publication | running_club | coach | race_organizer | fitness_site | gear_site | sports_data | university | local_nl | other
schema.qualification: Why this prospect fits (audience overlap, citation habits, NL relevance). Pass/fail notes.
schema.qualified: boolean — false means stop; do not contact
schema.contact: Address or handle used — never scrape illegally
schema.pitchDate: ISO date of first personalized pitch
schema.pitchAngle: One-sentence value for them (tool / study / explainer)
schema.followUpDate: ISO date of polite follow-up if any (max 1–2)
schema.link: Verified linking URL once live (or empty)
schema.targetUrl: Kitletics URL that received the link

instructions: Qualify before contact. Skip low-relevance or link-scheme sites.
Personalize every pitch; never blast identical templates at scale.
Do not buy links or participate in PBNs / link exchanges.
When a link is verified, also append to known-backlinks.json.
